PikoBuy spreadsheet

PikoBuy Spreadsheet: How to Compare Finds, Links and QC

A PikoBuy spreadsheet is most useful when it records a decision, not just a product link. Keep the exact listing title, selected variant, visible price, size information and the date you checked it. That creates a record you can compare after a seller changes a listing or a similar item appears.

PikoBuy QC photos

PikoBuy QC Photos: A Practical Warehouse Review Checklist

Warehouse photos are a checkpoint after an item arrives, not a certificate of quality. Compare them with the option you selected and the original listing: visible colour, label, quantity, obvious damage and supplied parts are useful checks.

PikoBuy shipping cost

PikoBuy Shipping Cost: Weight, Dimensions and Route Variables

International shipping is a separate decision from paying for the item. The published estimator asks for destination, product type, weight and dimensions; that is a useful reminder that a headline product price cannot predict a final parcel total.

Read the guides →

PikoBuy returns and tracking

PikoBuy Returns and Tracking: The Warehouse Window and Parcel Updates

PikoBuy’s published returns policy describes a five-day application window after an eligible item enters the warehouse. Eligibility depends on the seller’s return guarantee, the condition required for resale and the item type; it is not automatic.
